blocks.title: command-line arguments
blocks.description: Returns the list of command-line arguments passed to a Python script.

blocks.title: platform identifier
blocks.description: Returns a string identifying the platform (e.g., 'linux', 'win32').

blocks.title: join path components %1
blocks.description: Joins one or more path components intelligently.

blocks.title: path exists %1
blocks.description: Return True if path refers to an existing path or an open file descriptor.

blocks.title: base name of path %1
blocks.description: Return the base name of pathname path.

blocks.title: directory name of path %1
blocks.description: Return the directory name of pathname path.

blocks.title: split extension of path %1
blocks.description: Split the pathname path into a pair (root, ext).

blocks.title: create directory at path %1
blocks.description: Create a directory.

blocks.title: create directory (and parents) at path %1
blocks.description: Recursive directory creation function.

blocks.title: rename from %1 to %2
blocks.description: Rename the file or directory src to dst.

blocks.title: is path %1 a file?
blocks.description: Return True if path is an existing regular file.

blocks.title: is path %1 a directory?
blocks.description: Return True if path is an existing directory.

blocks.title: compile regex pattern %1
blocks.description: Compiles a regular expression pattern into a regex object.

blocks.title: search for pattern %1 in string %2
blocks.description: Scans through a string looking for the first location where the regular expression pattern produces a match.

blocks.title: match pattern %1 at start of string %2
blocks.description: If zero or more characters at the beginning of string match the regular expression pattern, return a corresponding match object.

blocks.title: find all matches for pattern %1 in string %2
blocks.description: Return all non-overlapping matches of pattern in string, as a list of strings.

blocks.title: replace matches of pattern %1 with %2 in string %3
blocks.description: Return the string obtained by replacing the leftmost non-overlapping occurrences of pattern in string by the replacement repl.

blocks.title: split string %1 by pattern %2
blocks.description: Split string by the occurrences of pattern.

blocks.title: escape special characters in %1
blocks.description: Escape special characters in a pattern.

blocks.title: from match %1 get group %2
blocks.description: Returns a specific subgroup of the match.

blocks.title: get all groups from match %1
blocks.description: Returns a tuple containing all the subgroups of the match.

blocks.title: parse JSON string %1
blocks.description: Deserialize a JSON string to a Python object.

blocks.title: chain iterables %1
blocks.description: Chains multiple iterables together into a single iterator.

blocks.title: permutations of %1 of length %2
blocks.description: Return successive r length permutations of elements in the iterable.

blocks.title: combinations of %1 of length %2
blocks.description: Return r length subsequences of elements from the input iterable.

blocks.title: cartesian product of iterables %1
blocks.description: Cartesian product of input iterables.

blocks.title: count from %1 with step %2
blocks.description: Creates an iterator that returns evenly spaced values starting with number start.

blocks.title: cycle through %1
blocks.description: Creates an iterator returning elements from the iterable and saving a copy of each. When the iterable is exhausted, return elements from the saved copy. Repeats indefinitely.

blocks.title: repeat %1 %2 times
blocks.description: Creates an iterator that returns object over and over again. If the times argument is specified, it will repeat that many times.

blocks.title: take from %1 while %2 is true
blocks.description: Creates an iterator that returns elements from the iterable as long as the predicate is true.

blocks.title: drop from %1 while %2 is true
blocks.description: Creates an iterator that drops elements from the iterable as long as the predicate is true.

blocks.title: filter from %1 where %2 is false
blocks.description: Creates an iterator that filters elements from iterable returning only those for which the predicate is false.

blocks.title: current date and time
blocks.description: Gets the current date and time.

blocks.title: date year %1 month %2 day %3
blocks.description: Creates a date object.

blocks.title: time hour %1 minute %2 second %3
blocks.description: Creates a time object.

blocks.title: datetime year %1 month %2 day %3 hour %4 minute %5 second %6
blocks.description: Creates a datetime object.

blocks.title: timedelta days %1 seconds %2 microseconds %3 milliseconds %4 minutes %5 hours %6 weeks %7
blocks.description: Creates a timedelta object.

blocks.title: format %1 with %2
blocks.description: Formats a datetime object to a string.

blocks.title: parse %1 with %2
blocks.description: Parses a string into a datetime object.

blocks.title: datetime from timestamp %1
blocks.description: Creates a datetime object from a Unix timestamp.

blocks.title: timestamp from %1
blocks.description: Converts a datetime object to a Unix timestamp.

blocks.title: get %1 from %2
blocks.description: Gets a specific attribute from a datetime object.

blocks.title: timezone UTC offset %1
blocks.description: Creates a timezone object with a UTC offset in hours.

blocks.title: convert %1 to timezone %2
blocks.description: Converts a datetime object to a specific timezone.

blocks.title: create Counter from %1
blocks.description: Creates a collections.Counter object from an iterable.

blocks.title: create deque from %1
blocks.description: Creates a collections.deque object from an iterable.

blocks.title: append %1 to deque %2
blocks.description: Appends an item to the right end of the deque.

blocks.title: append left %1 to deque %2
blocks.description: Appends an item to the left end of the deque.

blocks.title: pop from deque %1
blocks.description: Removes and returns an item from the right end of the deque.

blocks.title: pop left from deque %1
blocks.description: Removes and returns an item from the left end of the deque.

blocks.title: create defaultdict with default factory %1
blocks.description: Creates a collections.defaultdict with a specified default factory (e.g., int, list, str).
